results.title: Dream of Storks
results.overview: Based on her own experience, which she extends through the testimonies of other infertile people, director Élodie Lélu shows how Medically Assisted Procreation modifies the relationship to the body and to the imaginary.

results.title: Rocket Fuel
results.overview: On a Bradford estate, Lenny and Mullet find an abandoned car and turn it into a DIY spaceship. A kitchen sink sci-fi comedy about estate childhoods, big dreams and escaping without going anywhere.

results.title: Dakar: Race Against the Desert
results.overview: Elite racers and emerging talents battle extreme conditions and push their limits across Saudi Arabia's unforgiving desert in the legendary Dakar Rally, where teamwork and cutting-edge tech meet raw determination.

results.title: Ta
results.overview: In a bleak, dystopian modern city, an agent of the underworld intersects with the lives of those lost in despair — guiding them on a surreal, transformative journey into death and beyond.

results.title: The map my feet are on
results.original_title: O mapa em que estão os meus pés
results.overview: Sebastião decides to plant his heart in the place where he was born.

results.title: The Inner Flame
results.overview: A filmmaker arrives at the house where a friend disappeared. She inquires about her with a man who holds a candle in his hand; with an acolyte who enters people’s dreams; with a forgetful woman, with a denier, and manages to escape the seduction of a satanic group, but is captivated by a demon.

results.title: Mohar
results.overview: The story revolves around a schoolgirl who faces the hardships of poverty, discrimination, and the painful realities of early marriage. Her family, burdened by financial stress, sees little choice but to marry her off while she's still a child.

results.title: Living in the Last Days
results.overview: A young man looking for purpose and meaning meets a charismatic life coach and joins his multi-level marking company, only to discover it's a doomsday cult seeking the end of the world.

results.title: Cherubs
results.overview: In this dark comedy two exiled angels must document suicides for eternity. One has lost his faith, while the other, knows nothing of his role. Confronted with human suffering, they question pain, faith and existence, between dark humour and profound reflection.

results.title: Souvenir d'une Nuit de Jeunesse
results.overview: Alexandre and Marie, two young twenty-year-old lovers wake up in the early morning and experience an intimate scene that will lead them to remain silent.

results.title: Petals and Memories
results.overview: With the promise made to their deceased father in his heart, the older brother, Toshiki, has continued to protect his younger sister, Fumiko. Now that Fumiko is getting married, the burden he carried should have finally been lifted, but a long-buried "secret" of Fumiko has resurfaced.

results.title: Lone Star Shark 2
results.overview: After a trauma, a kayaker is stalked by a shark on a Texas lake.

results.title: Dancing Barefoot
results.overview: Two artists find each other in an experimental homage to images from famous album covers.

results.title: Rooftop Lempicka
results.overview: While her mother is expecting their second child, young Thi befriends Ngoc, a club waitress who has just moved in as a tenant in their family home. As their friendship grows, she discovers that Ngoc is secretly a sex worker. Meanwhile, an art book of Tamara de Lempicka’s female nudes, stolen from a bookshop, silently bears witness.

results.title: The Solitary Gourmet 2025 New Years Eve Special ~Refills will be delivered by Goro himself!
results.original_title: 孤独のグルメ2025大晦日スペシャル おかわりは、五郎セルフで運びます！
results.overview: nogashira Goro (Matsushige Yutaka) is tasked with procuring rice and ingredients for onigiri (rice balls) to be distributed at a New Year's Eve countdown event at Asakusa Hanayashiki Amusement Park. A job request he can't refuse, Goro, along with his Mini,  set off on the long journey, from Sado Island, Niigata to Yonezawa, Yamagata, to collect the perfect onigiri ingredients.  As Goro races to beat the deadline, he finds himself hungry and indulges in the bounty of the sea and mountains he encounters at every stop... What kind of gourmet delights will Goro discover this year? Will he be able to finish off New Year's Eve with freshly cooked onigiri rice balls during the live broadcast? Also for the first time in five years, this 2025 New Year's Eve Special will feature a partial live broadcast!

results.title: Aro berria
results.overview: San Sebastian, 1978. The workers at the water meter factory hold an assembly to discuss a strike, which ultimately fails. Disappointed, the most non-conformist workers turn their aspirations for radical transformation towards more intimate spheres. Some leave the factory to join an isolated community in the mountains, where dozens of young people embarked on an intense journey of shared cathartic experiences.

results.title: Thoughts on Peace in an Air Raid
results.original_title: Роздуми про мир під час повітряного нальоту
results.overview: On a warm fall day, a construction worker decides to have a lunch break, a young girl takes care of her elderly grandmother, a film director tries to edit his documentary footage.

results.title: 4 Wheels
results.overview: Four friends who grew up in the same yard embark on an adventure after losing a classic car belonging to the family of the girl the romantic and charismatic Khagani loves in a gamble.

results.title: Imago
results.overview: As Ana's mom transforms into an insect, their codependent relationship becomes unbearable.
